title: Fear
line: Awareness before action. The forest does not attack; it watches.

title: Shame
line: Seeing clearly. The hidden truths, and the one who feels like an impostor.

title: Grief
line: Saying it. Releasing what was withheld.

title: Loneliness
line: Forgiving. Love from family, and the wound carried since episode one.

title: Trust
line: Making and feeling. Attachment, intimacy, depth.

title: The Mirror
line: Landing. No enemy, only her reflection, exactly her size.
